"Just one more round." Somehow, that turned into ten.

Learn the rules in seconds. Laugh at the same screen all night. FlipBAKA! is that kind of game.

Your Weapon Is the Floor

No guns. No swords. Just the panels under everyone's feet. Flip one at the right moment and whoever is standing on it — monster, best friend, or the CPU Pal fighting beside you — goes flying off the island. The floor doesn't care whose side you're on. Flip first, apologize later.

When someone sends you into the sea, there is exactly one thing to shout: "BAKAAA!!" — Japanese for "you idiot." Said with love, mostly. That's where the name comes from.


Knock your Pal off three times, though, and it stops being your Pal. It gets angry, and it comes for you.

10 Seconds to Learn, All Night to Play

Move. Flip. That's the whole tutorial. Hold it to charge and you flip three panels at once instead of one, enough to sweep a whole row off the island. Easy to pick up, satisfying to master — what decides a match is positioning and reading the timing.

Three Ways to Play. Solo or With Friends.

Every mode works locally (everyone around one screen) or online (friends far away). Only one of you owns the game? Remote Play Together lets you invite the rest.

1. Stage Mode — Clear 8 stages and collect their skills!

Eight stages, each with its own cast of enemies, and two bosses waiting for you. Every clear earns you a skill — and the right skill turns the stage that wrecked you into a warm-up.

2. Dungeon Mode — Explore the dungeon!

Explore a dungeon room by room. Flip enemies off the floor, choose to dodge a fight, or grab treasure and move on. Strengthen yourself with items and skills as you explore, face hazards and bosses, and decide how to press deeper.

3. PvP Mode — Two rulesets.

Race for points by hunting enemies, or kick your friends off the island and be the last one standing. Up to 8 players online (4 on one couch), team battles included.

Finished the story? Endless Mode throws wave after wave at you for the high score. 36 Steam achievements. And there may or may not be a hidden mode.

That Feeling, One More Time

Remember passing the controller around one screen, shouting at every close call? FlipBAKA! is a love letter to the golden-age games we grew up on — now with online play and voice chat. The couch can be anywhere.

Fully charging a left or right leg jump makes you jump and flip in that direction.

Tapping left or right leg jump makes you glide in that direction.

Release both legs at the same time for a vertical jump, or slightly stagger your kicks to arc your trajectory. Miss the timing window, and the second kick becomes a mid-air spin.

The web grapple is a versatile tool that can be used to swing across large gaps or instantly stop your momentum.

You can also reel the web grapple in and out to catch flies or pull yourself up onto ledges.

Kicks can be used to spin mid-air, adjust your angle on a web, or flip yourself upright if you land upside down.

Collect all the flies to beat the level. Replay stages to improve your time and collect trophies.

Free Demo Available Now

Explore for materials, forge artifacts, and try the turn-based strategy gameplay. The current demo is single-player against AI opponents and does not include online multiplayer. We recommend starting with the Tutorial in the main menu.

Enjoying the demo? Add Fliprium to your wishlist to be notified when the full game releases. Share bugs and suggestions in the Steam Community discussions.

About the Full Game

Inspired by ancient Chinese card-and-tile games such as Mahjong and Yezi Xi, Fliprium uses simple rules to create endless variation and strategic depth. In its distinctive world, you explore for artifact materials and plan your forging direction and route.

Four-player matches are deep table-reading duels, where a single card can change the direction of the game.

Key Features

  • 336 material cards: 27 basic materials with 12 cards each, plus 12 Dragon Scales
  • 27 regular artifacts across weapon, armor, and ring slots
  • 28 forgeable artifacts, including 27 regular artifacts and Dragon Power
  • 15 endgame multiplier patterns that can combine to boost your score
  • 10 playable adventurers, each with a unique trait
  • 4 charm types: Miracle, Precision, Convergence, and Shift, with quantities determined by player count and the actual number of starting cards
  • A 361-hex map with starting areas and explorable tiles
  • Solo play against five AI difficulty levels
  • Matches for 2, 3, or 4 players, with online play by friend invitation
  • 9 interface languages supported



You can also read the table, create opportunities, and claim opponents' discards to complete artifacts and accelerate toward victory.



Each playable adventurer has a unique trait, and four powerful charm types are scattered across the board. Used well, charms and adventurer traits can unleash dazzling chain-forging bursts that keep pushing the score ceiling.



Multiple scoring patterns and extreme multipliers let luck and judgment forge a legendary hand.

Adventurers

Choose from ten distinctive adventurers: Traveling Merchant, Witch, Thief, Alchemist, Oracle, Bard, Blacksmith, Elven Tailor, Dwarf Miner, and Mechanical Golem.

Forget Pre-written Options. Say It in Your Own Words.

Flirt Simulator is a first-person, AI-driven dating simulation set in New York. It has no dialogue trees and no scripted lines. You type whatever you want, and every character answers naturally, in real time, as the person they are.

Swipe, Match, Message

It all starts on your in-game phone. Browse profiles on the dating app and read what each person does, what they're into and what they're looking for. Then swipe. When you match, they write first, and what they say depends on your own profile. Keep the conversation going, and if it's going well, ask them out.

The Date Is Where It Counts

Pick where you're going, either coffee at a cozy cafe or dinner at a restaurant, and decide whether to bring flowers, chocolate or a small gift. At the table you talk face to face, order from the menu and see your food and drinks arrive.

As the evening goes on, you can make your move: hold their hand, ask for a kiss, share a dessert, ask them to be yours, or suggest leaving together. Every move is a real question, and they can say no.


At the end someone has to deal with the bill. You can pay, split it or let them pay, and every character feels differently about that.

Characters Who Feel Real

Each character has their own personality, temperament, tastes, life story and memory. They remember what you said and how you treated them. Their Attraction, Trust, Respect and Comfort, and the Tension between you, shift with every message, and small notes show you when something you said worked or didn't. Their faces react as you talk: a smile that turns into a laugh, a skeptical brow, a nervous glance away.

Who You Are Matters

Before you start, you choose who you are from ten starting characters, each with their own looks, charisma, build and height. Everyone has their own taste, so what one person finds irresistible, another won't care about at all. A bad first impression doesn't end your chances. The right words can still win them over.

Features

  • Free-text conversations with no dialogue options
  • A dating app on your phone: swipe, match and chat
  • Face-to-face dates at a restaurant or a cafe, with a real menu and the bill at the end
  • Six romantic moves to try at the table, each one a question they can turn down
  • Characters with memory, personality and changing feelings
  • Lifelike faces with live expressions and natural eye contact
  • Ten starting characters, and every person you meet has their own taste
  • Character collection cards and Steam achievements
  • Fully playable in 25 languages; characters always reply in the language you play in

An internet connection is required: character responses are generated live by AI.

A tiny treehouse lives in the corner of your desktop.

Prince Tomato times your focus sessions, Todudu keeps an eye on your to-do list, and Lily plays you something soft. They don't take up much room and they won't nag. They just stay close while you work, study, or take a break.

Focusing, finishing tasks, and playing with the fairies all earn wish points. Spend them on new outfits, playlists, and treehouse decorations. As your wish points add up, the treehouse grows, and that's how Todudu and Lily move in.

When it's time to focus, ask Prince Tomato to keep time. While you work, he reads, paints, or knits beside you. When time's up he lets you know and drops a few little gifts. Sweep your mouse over them to turn them into wish points.

Write today's tasks on the to-do board and Todudu will keep watch. Each time you check one off, she hops over, pulls up a carrot and eats it. If a task sits for too long, she'll give you a gentle reminder.

Music in the treehouse belongs to Lily. Over a hundred gentle tracks are spread across more than a dozen albums, from music-box lullabies and Chopin nocturnes to lo-fi, vaporwave and medieval tavern tunes. Save your favorites, press play, and she sings along.

Finish several pomodoros in a row, leave a task sitting too long, or let the music go quiet for a while, and the fairies will notice and pop up to say something. Sometimes Todudu hides in the grass and waits for you to find her.

Put up the rainy-day gate and you'll find a watering can hanging on it. Drag it to water the fairies, or the ground to make flowers pop up. Keep poking the decorations and a tiny hat might fall off for a fairy to wear all day.

Each fairy has a short comic story of their own. It unlocks as the fairy levels up with you, or you can spend wish points to open it early.

Once you've saved enough wish points, make a wish. Outfits, playlists, backgrounds, plants, and new looks for the timer and to-do board are all in the pool. There are no microtransactions; wish points come only from spending time together. More fairies will move into the treehouse later on.

Everything you collect, from backgrounds and plants to gates and trinkets, lives in your collection book, ready to put on display whenever you like.

Fluendora: The Realm of Scribes is a relaxing multiplayer and single-player word-puzzle adventure where strategy meets tranquility. In this cozy experience, players engage in a unique word-building challenge, either competing for the highest score or enjoying a peaceful solo session in a beautifully crafted low-poly environment.

🏆 Play WITH Chat (The Ultimate Word Tournament)

      (⭐chat's favourite mode)

Don't want to play competitively? Host a realm-wide tournament instead and let your chat steal the spotlight while you play host.

  • How it works: Fire up the tournament mode and watch your chat come alive. Anyone can participate instantly by typing !w <word> directly into the stream chat.

  • The Arena: Every round, a new set of letters is revealed. Viewers hunt for the best words, climbing a live, on-screen leaderboard in real-time.

  • Scribe's Privilege: Do you own Fluendora on Steam? Link your Steam account in the game options to unlock a permanent perk: submit 2 words per round instead of 1 and dominate your favorite streamer's leaderboard!

⚔️ Play VS Chat (The Ultimate 1v1 Showdown)

Are you a streamer who thinks they have the ultimate vocabulary? Put it to the test against your entire community.

  • How it works: You face off 1v1 against "The Chat," a custom AI bot powered entirely by viewer votes.

  • The Chat's Move: Viewers type words into your chat, and at the end of the turn timer, the most-voted word is locked in.

  • Mind Games: By default, your hand cards are displayed face-up on screen so viewers can plan their counter-moves. Want to keep them guessing instead? Use our pre-made stream overlay (link accessible directly in the game) to cover your hand and hide your strategy from stream-snipers!


Gameplay Overview

Players take turns forming words by combining 6 personal letters and 6 shared letters from the river. Words are automatically validated and scored, with special bonuses awarded for longer words.

  • Utilize Special Abilities: Use Lock to freeze crucial letters and block your opponent, or Flush to completely refresh the letters in the river.

  • End of the Game: The match ends when no more words can be formed, or when all scribes skip their turn in succession.

Supported Languages for Word Validation

  • English

  • Czech (After enabling experimental mode in Options)

  • Slovak (After enabling experimental mode in Options)

Lore

Legends say the land took its name from the sacred river Fluent, whose waters flow with such clarity that words come to life within them.

Today, we know this realm as Fluendora: The Realm of Scribes, a sanctuary where language is not just spoken, but where under the glow of the moonlight, scribes gather to weave every word from the heart of the stream.

The river is waiting, will you join the flow?

Gameplay details

6+6 letters

Players take turns forming words using a combination of 6 personal letters and 6 shared river letters. Words are automatically validated and scored, with bonuses for longer words.

Expand your vocabulary with every game.

Submit your best word

Your goal is to score the most points by submitting high-value words.

  • Bonus points: Words with 5 or more letters grant bonus points (up to +5).

  • Special Actions: Use abilities like Lock to keep key letters, or Flush to refresh the river.

  • Special Letters (Wildcards):

    • Vowel Wildcard: Represents any vowel (Value: 1 point).

    • Star Wildcard: Represents any letter (Value: 0 points).

Get advantage by using special moves

  • Lock: Locks a specific letter in the river for 1 turn. Opponents can’t use it during their next round. Gains 1 charge every 3 turns.

  • Flush River: Replaces all non-locked letters in the river with new ones, forcing opponents to rethink their options.

Customize your game experience

Looking for a more dynamic or challenging experience? Adjust the turn duration or minimum word length and see how your opponents handle the pressure.

Analyze your performance

Rewind your run. Find better plays. Expand your vocabulary with every game.

Coming in the full version

  • Competitive matchmaking: Face players at your skill level and climb the ranked ladder.

  • Full word alternatives: Go beyond the obvious, explore all possible word options, not just a limited few.

  • Collections: Find the right words and complete curated collections.

Every run is a factory you've never built before.

Draft nodes. Wire them together. Resources flow. Rooms demand throughput.

Drag, wire, press ▶ Run Production.

What you do

Each room sets one objective: collect 400 energy, hold ≥20 matter/tick for 20 ticks in a row, clear every track before the run ends,... and hands you a credit budget.

Nothing is on a timer while you build. Wire sources into amplifiers into sinks, buy the piece you're missing from the room shop, take as long as you want. When the pipeline looks right, press ▶ Run Production.

The simulation runs a fixed number of ticks and scores what flows into your sinks. Fall short and you can rewire and retry, each retry costs budget. Clear it and you choose: bank the reward, or push for the bonus target and risk carrying a penalty into the next room.

Between rooms you draft new nodes and relics from the Spoils screen, then pick your path through a branching map of rooms, shops, rests and events. Your pipeline grows, warps, and either carries you to the boss or seizes up on the way.

What makes it different

  • A combo engine, built fresh every run. Individual nodes are simple. The run is about the multiplier chain you stumble into: an amp that scales with the amps upstream, a capacitor that stores three dead ticks into one spike that clears the threshold... Factory-game parts, deckbuilder pacing.

  • Packs decide what run you're playing. Eight packs, each a complete strategic twist on the same substrate: Chaos gambles, Toll pays a known price, Power stacks raw multipliers, Routing shapes the flow, Tempo reshapes when it arrives, Synthesis converts anything into anything, Economy turns credits into throughput. Toggle them at run setup to concentrate the draw.

  • Difficulty you opt into. The Heat Pact lets you accept conditions: tighter objectives, leaner budgets, volatile nodes, costlier retries,... for more Heat, and more Flux when you win. Clear a Heat tier to unlock the next.

A factory that stays.

Runs end. The Foundry doesn't. Every run, won or lost, banks its last room as a blueprint; wire them together on a floor that stays, and what it lights is what your next run starts with. Nothing runs while you're away.

Features

  • 71 nodes across 8 packs: sources, amplifiers, splitters, gates, converters, sinks,...

  • 23 relics - permanent, run-long rule-benders

  • 51 rooms and 5 bosses - some of them unlocked by how you win, not by how often

  • A branching map each run with rooms, elites, rests, events,...

  • A 42-node research tree you feed, not buy. It runs on what your Foundry makes

  • The Foundry - every run, won or lost, leaves its last room behind as a blueprint. Place blueprints on a factory floor that stays between runs and wire what they make into the research trees and pack gates: what lights is what your next run starts with. Nothing runs while you're away

  • Pack Filters - an unlock that lets you switch packs off at run setup and concentrate the draw into the build you want

  • A loss still pays Flux - no run is wasted

  • Full English and French - text and UI

Demo

A free demo is available. It covers the opening rooms and the first boss, and your progress carries nothing into the full game but the knowledge of how to wire a merger. The Foundry is in the full game, not the demo.

Made by one person

Fluxgates is built solo. Wishlist it to get told the day it launches - that signal is the whole marketing budget.

“Fly&Goal” is a casual puzzle game where you play disc golf while navigating holes that showcase the changing seasons. Read the wind to choose your throw, dodge obstacles, and aim to clear all 12 courses, each with 9 holes.

Read the Wind and Plan Ahead

On each hole, you’ll be dealt cards indicating the type of throw (4 types) and throwing distance, and you’ll need to use them at the optimal moment. Wind blows across the course, and its direction and strength change with every throw. Since the Frisbee is affected by the wind, the trajectory and landing spot shown on the card will vary depending on when you throw. Choose one of the four directions and give it a try. Since you can’t fight the wind, it might actually be better to throw the disc away from the goal sometimes...

Play casually as many times as you like

You can call “time” at any moment, and there are no penalties for failure. It’s okay if the disc lands in the pond or flies out of bounds! By using both your head and your hands to throw the disc however you like, you might just figure out the best path to take.

Design holes however you like in Editor Mode

In Editor Mode, you can freely design and play with combinations of holes and obstacles. You can also publish your creations so other players can play them.

Matches are more than simple stat checks. Players move, contest the ball, push forward, and look for openings on their own. Time slows while dragging a card, giving you a moment to read the field before making your move.

For The Realm is a cooperative deckbuilding roguelike RPG set in a dark fantasy world on the edge of ruin.


Gather your party, build your deck, and fight through branching encounters where every choice matters. Each hero brings their own cards, abilities, and role to the team, but no one survives the realm alone.


Battle monsters, explore dangerous regions, uncover the story behind the spreading chaos, and adapt your strategy with every run. Victory takes more than strong cards. It takes teamwork, timing, and the will to stand together when the realm begins to fall.

About Forest TD

In a forest overrun by monsters, explore the map, protect the trees, and transform them into different types of defensive towers.

Key Features

• Move freely and fight across an open map

• Transform different trees into rapid-fire, heavy-strike, light-energy, and other defensive towers

• Wield Fire, Water, Wind, Earth, Light, Dark, Nature, and Arcane abilities

• Adapt your defensive layout to enemy numbers and routes

• Survive increasingly powerful waves of enemies

Forged Cards is a roguelike deckbuilder where you don't collect cards, you make them. Take up the hammer of a journeyman smith, gather ingots and recipes, and forge cards in your deck by hand: choose its effects, temper its power, and inscribe it with conditions that turn simple strikes into engines.

Forge Your Own Cards

Every card starts as a mold with open slots. Slot in Casts (what it does), set its Temper (how hard it hits) and Duration (how long it lasts), then etch Inscriptions that generate and spend Flux for bonus payoffs. Found a recipe for Burn? Pair it with Damage for a unique effect.

King of the Hill Mode

Each day, players attempt the same run. The final fight is against the ghost of the player before you (their deck, their items). Beat this ghost and you are the now the King of the Hill. Your build now defends the summit, and if it's strong enough it may hold against the challengers climbing behind you. If your reign lasts the longest during the day, you will be crowned the champion. 

Co-Op (2 to 4 players)

Team up with your closet friends and journey together through the world of Forged Cards. Discover synergies that only exist when there's more than one smith on the field. Plan out your assault as a team for maximum carnage. Gather items and inscriptions found only in co-op. But beware, there are new enemies that show up only when there's a party to crash. 

Outsmart, Don't Outdraw

Combat is simultaneous. You see the enemy's hand — but not the order they'll play it. Arrange your three cards into positions, lock in, and watch both sides resolve in lockstep. A well-placed Block blanks their opening blow; a Vulnerable at position one supercharges everything after it. Sequencing is key.

Every Run Is Yours

  • Explore random maps across 4 distinct biomes

  • 30 Casts across three smithing schools: aggression, protection, and attrition. Combinable into multi-alloy cards

  • Inscriptions that build lifesteal, executes, stuns, and combo engines out of simple parts

  • Over 100 items, mystery events, and boss-forged molds to bend each run around

  • Draft mode: build your starting deck one pick at a time

  • 15 stackable Masteries for escalating difficulty, plus an uncapped Endless mode

  • Fully seeded runs — share a seed, share the exact run

Something appeared on the desktop.

It cannot be deleted. It is quietly growing. And even when you are not watching, time continues to pass for it.

FORM is an atmospheric idle life simulation about raising a mysterious digital entity that lives on the RÆLOS desktop. Feed it, interact with it, observe its behavior, and respond to its needs. The care routine you establish shapes FORM's development, the state of the system, and the encounters waiting ahead.

This is not only a game about raising an entity. As FORM changes, the desktop changes with it; new files, quests, processes, games, and words whose meaning you do not yet understand begin to appear.

Time passes even while you are away

When you leave the game, FORM does not freeze and wait for you. When you return, the time that passed is reflected in RÆLOS: FORM may have grown, its needs may have changed, it may have moved closer to a new phase, or it may have begun to carry the marks of your absence.

Check in for short care sessions, focus on quests and minigames, or stay away longer and discover what changed when you return. Offline progression does not finish the game for you; active care, observation, and resource management remain important.

Raise FORM and learn its behavior

FORM's hunger, fatigue, happiness, neglect, and danger state are reflected in its behavior. You learn to read it not only through numbers, but through its movement, sound, appearance, and the traces it leaves across RÆLOS.

Feed it, interact with it, observe it, and use phase-specific actions when the time is right. Beginning as a small seed, FORM passes through ten distinct growth phases, each with its own visual identity and behavior.

Explore a playable desktop

RÆLOS is more than a background. It is an interactive desktop environment with windows, applications, and an internal structure of its own.

  • Investigate records, hidden folders, and newly appearing files in the file explorer.

  • Browse forums, news, system pages, and the hardware shop on RÆLOS Net.

  • Follow RÆLMAIL messages, notifications, and system logs.

  • Manage your wallet, earn RÆLOS Credits, and purchase hardware that improves your system.

Quests, economy, and minigames

Caring for FORM requires resources. Complete long-term quest chains and daily quests to earn RÆLOS Credits and Growth Points. Use those resources for care, hardware, and system upgrades.

Different games unlock as the phases advance. A total of 23 minigames await you: 4 dedicated games and 19 arcade variants built around reflexes, memory, timing, attention, and pattern recognition. Each game records how many times you played, your best score, and your total score.

Every cycle leaves a trace

FORM's life does not remain the same forever. Death is not an ending, but the beginning of a new cycle. Some traces, behaviors, and gains from previous lives carry into the cycles that follow.

Rather than repeating the same path every time, observe how FORM changes, what it seems to remember, and how RÆLOS reacts to those changes.

The answers will not be given directly

What FORM is and why it exists inside RÆLOS are never explained outright. To get closer to the answers, you must piece together files, messages, forum posts, processes, and system records.

Listen to the VELUN words that emerge over time. Pay attention to repeating signs. Some records provide answers, while others leave only new questions.

Nobody explained what it is. Understanding it is up to you.

Forsaken Trials is a hard, momentum-driven third-person platformer where skill and precision are everything.

You are a cursed adventurer navigating ancient ruins. Every movement counts — commit to your sprint, time your vault, land your jump, or fall to the stone below. Death is instant. Restart is instant. Learn the path, master the rhythm, beat your best time.

Movement that matters. Sprint builds momentum over time. Jump height is fixed; horizontal distance depends entirely on your speed at takeoff. No air control. No checkpoints. Every decision made before you leave the ground.

Ancient ruins to explore. Seven training levels teach the basics. Five Temple of Initiation levels test your skill. Three full campaign series await those who survive.

Master or quit. There are no difficulty settings. No tutorials beyond the training grounds. Just you, the stone, and the curse that keeps pulling you back for one more try.

Explore the field with up to 4 players, gather resources, and prepare for the enemies that swarm in at night.

Play solo or cooperate with up to 4 players to devise a strategy and survive until the very end.

You must gather as many resources as possible during the day.

Use the resources you collect to craft better tools and produce weapons to defend your base.

Defend your base against the waves of enemies.

Survive until the end!

What actions will you take to stay alive? Survive in this dangerous world until the very end in your own way!

A Classic Brick Breaker Rebuilt as a Roguelite

Fortress Breaker is a roguelite brick breaker that expands the classic paddle and ball gameplay with procedurally generated runs (with shareable seeds), boss battles, upgrades, and persistent unlocks.

Choose which fortress to attack next using the world map. Earn gold by destroying blocks and spend it in the shop between levels on upgrades that change the way your paddle, ball, and attacks behave.



Defeat Bosses

Fortress bosses introduce unique challenges beyond normal levels. Defeating bosses unlocks upgrades in the Armory and unlocks special blocks used in the next fortresses.

Each campaign creates a run seed that can be shared with friends, allowing everyone to play the same sequence of generated fortresses and compare how far they can progress. Preset Challenge Seeds provide additional ways to play.



Extra Modes

After beating the campaign, continue your run in Endless Mode as the difficulty keeps increasing. Or take on Boss Rush to revisit defeated bosses.

Fortress Breaker has distinct music for normal fortress battles, bosses, the shop, and the armory.  There are also sound effects for paddle impacts, block destruction, explosions, purchases, and collapsing fortresses.

A little tree to keep you company while you work

Fortune Tree is a relaxing desktop idle game. Let your tree collect Wish Energy while you get things done, then take a quick break to click, upgrade, and see what it grows into.

[h2]Grow as you type—or just let it idle[/h2]

Turn on optional keystroke counting to earn Wish Energy from everyday typing. Prefer to leave it off? Idle progress and clicks work too.

Small upgrades, new looks

Start with a fortune tree, spend your earnings on upgrades, and unlock new plant forms. There is always a little more to grow.

Keep it quiet when you need to focus

Switch to the minimal display and let your tree sit in a corner of your desktop. Keystroke counting can be switched off in Settings. It counts presses without recording what you type.

A little greenery. A little progress. A little good fortune.

Bon Voyage!


This is a dice-based board game inspired by the Age of Exploration.
The roll of the dice and your strategy determine your fate.

Forturia is a fantasy world inspired by the 16th-century Age of Exploration. You take on the role of a young captain leading a small trading company, traveling from port to port across the globe, buying and selling goods, opening up unknown seas, and taking on royal missions from your kingdom.

But you are not the only one seeking fortune on these waters.
A colorful cast of rival captains is also sailing the world, each driven by their own ambitions.

Which route will you take?
Which ports will you trade in?
Will you prioritize royal missions, or chase a chance at a massive profit?

Every choice you make can change the course of your destiny.

A Different Grand Voyage, Woven by Dice Every Time

Forturia: Trade Route Pioneers is a new kind of seafaring strategy game that blends board game movement, trading, strategy, and adventure.

Roll the dice to travel along sea routes, then buy and sell trade goods in ports around the world. Read the market, stack up profits, grow your fleet, and aim to become the greatest trading company in the world.

With maps that change every time you play, market prices that shift constantly, and rival captains competing for the same opportunities, no two voyages are ever the same.

A Free Voyage Across the World

A vast ocean awaits, filled with countless ports, trade goods, and undiscovered routes.

Discover new waters, expand the world map, and build your own ideal trade routes.

Sometimes storms will throw your plans into chaos. Sometimes unexpected fortune will smile upon you. Every voyage creates a new story.

A Party Adventure to Enjoy, Laugh, and Compete With Others

The world of Forturia is not only for solo players who want to take their time and plan carefully.

With online and local multiplayer, it can also be enjoyed as a party game that is easy to play with family and friends.

“If only I had one more space, I could have completed my royal mission!”
“You sold at that port? I wasn’t ready for that!”
“You’re using that item now!?”

Unexpected twists created by the dice, combined with the mind games between players, make every session feel like its own drama.

Luck alone will not bring victory.
But even the best strategy can be laughed away by the goddess of dice.

Because no one knows who will win until the very end, every voyage is filled with cheers, groans, and laughter.

It is a new seafaring party game where everyone can gather, compete, and have a great time.

A Story-Rich Campaign Mode and an Endlessly Replayable Versus Mode

Enjoy a story-rich campaign mode filled with meaningful encounters and journeys across the world, as well as a randomly generated versus mode where you can freely play against COM opponents or friends.

Roll the dice that decide your fate, trade from port to port, and outmaneuver rival captains.
Lead your trading company to glory in a fantasy world inspired by the Age of Exploration.

There Is More Than One Path to Victory

Build a vast fortune.

Complete more royal missions than anyone else.

Monopolize rare trade goods.

Explore the world and open up new sea routes.

What kind of captain you become is up to you.

Luck alone is not enough.
Strategy alone is not enough.

Only the captain who can master both fortune and judgment will become the ruler of Forturia.

Now, raise your sails.

Beyond the trade routes no one has yet discovered.

Development Staff

Developer: FUJIYAMA ENTERTAINMENT
Director & Original Concept: Shunsuke Katsumata
Character Design: Shu-Chun
Sound Design: Soma

Brought to you by a small development team of four to five people.
We hope everyone will have a great time playing it together.

Ignite engines, buckle up, and now dive into the epic sci-fi universe of Isaac Asimov’s Foundation—the beloved novels that also inspired the acclaimed Apple TV+ series!

As the Galactic Empire falls, new factions rise. The fate of humanity is in your hands. Command your starship, explore uncharted space, and dominate this sci-fi saga blending deep strategy with intense action!

Immersive Story: The Master Trader's Galactic Odyssey

  • Play a unique role as an interstellar trader/bounty hunter/political strategist navigating between the Empire, Foundation, other factions and rebels, uncovering the secrets of Seldon’s Plan and confronting with the mysterious enemy the Mule.

Mothership Simulation: A Sweet Space Home

  • Construct your spaceship! Build different cabins to offer everything you need to survive: food, water recyclers, and steel resource... With cannons armed on, it's time to pilot your mobile space haven into the blue sky!

  • Foster bonds with your crew, handle emergencies together and breathe life into ship. Every daily greeting adds a little more belonging to your adventures through space.

Star Crew: A Band of Vagabonds

  • Encounter heroes of various backgrounds and appearances in space and invite them onboard: a robot with encyclopedic knowledge but misses sarcasm, the legendary space cowboy, even the most wanted criminal.... Roam the cosmos together and write your legend among the stars!

Thrilling TPS Combat: Assemble Ultimate Squads

  • Engage in blistering firefights across exotic planets and derelict space ruins. Tear through hordes of enemies with 15+ heroes - mix tank-dps-healer trios to create your ultimate 3-hero strike team.

  • Screen-filling explosions drench every planetfall in pure adrenaline release—total vaporization victory.

Galaxy Wars: A Rising Trade Empire!

  • Master three combat craft classes—Kinetic, Ion, and Beam—and deploy them in optimal formations with different flagships, assigning the right commanders to unlock their full power. Strategize your fleets to exploit and protect your galaxy's trade routes from threats and rivals.

  • Join powerful alliances and showcase your RTS skills in large-scale interstellar conflicts. Rise as a dominant force in the galactic economy.

EMBARK NOW!
Write Your Sci-Fi Legend • Build your Ideal Flagship • Build Trade Networks • Forge Your Galactic Destiny!

You suddenly wake up in a whole different world, and it's filled with... foxgirls!

One moment everything is ordinary. The next, your memories go blank... and you open your eyes to a world unlike anything you've known, surrounded by curious girls with fluffy ears staring at you expectantly.

What happened? Did you die? Does it even matter?

You're already here. Might as well make the most of it.

Fox Idle is an idle incremental RPG where you level up skills, gather resources, fight monsters, and make progress alongside your fox-eared companions.

  • Mine ores with Kohaku

  • Chop wood with Kaede

  • Forage herbs and mushrooms with Keeno

  • Go fishing with Neeki

  • Hunt wildlife with Remea

  • Quarry stone with Ishiko

  • Scout for hidden treasures with Nayo

  • Catch bugs with Shayna

Put your gathered resources to work! Forge weapons and armor, brew potions, cook meals, craft jewelry, and more. Every item you make opens new doors across the game and fills up your knowledge books.

Fight your way to the top. The monsters of this world are yours to challenge, and Akari will fight right at your side, healing you when you need it. Each victory makes you stronger, unlocking tougher enemies and greater rewards! Prove yourself powerful enough and you'll face the mighty Titans.

The foxgirls will keep you busy. Quests and favors wait across the whole game, from simple tasks to bounties on the strongest monsters alive. Grow your friendship with every fox, and adopt pets to feed and raise along the way.

Away from the game? Your foxes keep watch. Time spent offline builds up Fox Power, and you can spend it to boost your combat or your gathering and crafting when you return.

Afterburners on. Target locked. “Fox Two!”

Straight into the next turn. In Fox Two Protocol, you take a modern fighter into air-to-air combat and ground-attack missions. The landscape slips beneath you, a target comes into your sights, and a beautiful flight becomes a fight.

Every sortie gives you something to improve: a cleaner approach, a tighter manoeuvre, a faster mission. Accessible arcade action and comfortable keyboard-and-mouse controls let you get straight to the joy of flying.

Pick your challenge

Fly the campaign, challenge another pilot to a PvP duel, race against the clock in Time Attack, or take on an endless mission. Return to familiar missions and find a better way through.

Chase personal bests and compete on global leaderboards for the campaign, Time Attack and endless mode. See how you measure up against other pilots, then take another shot.

Build your style of combat

Progress your pilot through an upgrade tree featuring distinctive equipment. Choose improvements, experiment with combinations and find a configuration that suits the way you fight.

Take on air and ground targets with missiles, bombs and guns. Give your fighter a look you like with a choice of skins.

One more flight?

Some flights are for the view. Others are for the personal best you know you can beat. There is always a reason for one more sortie.

A note from the developer

I'm making Fox Two Protocol solo, out of a love of aircraft and the sheer joy of flight. Your impressions and feedback help me make the game better.

Try the demo and add Fox Two Protocol to your wishlist.

about_html:
Fragmenta: Ancient Egypt is a relaxing 3D reconstruction puzzle experience where shattered artifacts of one of history's greatest civilizations await restoration.

Explore a curated collection of ancient Egyptian treasures, monuments, statues, ceremonial objects, and architectural relics. Each object is procedurally fragmented every time you play, creating a unique reconstruction challenge with no two puzzles ever exactly alike.

From small ceremonial artifacts to towering monuments, carefully examine, rotate, and place hundreds of fragments as you gradually restore the original masterpiece piece by piece. Choose your preferred difficulty, from quick and relaxing restorations to large-scale reconstructions that can take hours to complete.

As fragments return to their rightful places, damaged relics are transformed back into complete works of art. Every successful restoration expands your collection and preserves a piece of the ancient world.

Whether you are seeking a calm and meditative experience, a satisfying spatial challenge, or simply the joy of bringing order from chaos, Fragmenta: Ancient Egypt invites you to uncover the past one fragment at a time.

Restore forgotten wonders. Reconstruct history.

Deep beneath the ruins of a forgotten kingdom lies a mystery that has remained hidden for generations.

When Lidi discovers strange ember fragments scattered throughout the abandoned lands, his curiosity leads him into an unexpected adventure. Explore atmospheric pixel-art environments, solve environmental puzzles, light forgotten torches, and uncover the secrets surrounding the legendary Last Ember.

Explore a Forgotten Kingdom

Journey through handcrafted levels featuring abandoned castles, forgotten sanctuaries, underground mines, and ancient ruins. Every location rewards exploration with hidden collectibles, optional discoveries, and secrets waiting to be found.

Light the Way

Use your lighter to ignite ancient torches that serve as checkpoints throughout your journey. Some torches reveal hidden paths, activate forgotten mechanisms, or guide you toward unexplored areas.

Solve Environmental Puzzles

Carefully observe your surroundings to activate ancient machinery, unlock hidden passages, and overcome environmental challenges. Exploration and curiosity are just as important as platforming skill.

Master Precision Platforming

Run, jump, climb ladders, slide through narrow passages, swing across dangerous gaps, and avoid deadly hazards while navigating the kingdom's forgotten ruins.

Search Every Corner

Collect coins, discover hidden artifacts, recover mysterious ember fragments, and explore every level to uncover its secrets. Purchase maps from the in-game shop to help locate collectibles you may have missed.

Features

  • Atmospheric pixel-art visuals

  • Eight handcrafted levels

  • Exploration-focused gameplay

  • Environmental puzzles

  • Precision platforming

  • Hidden collectibles and secrets

  • In-game map shop

  • Steam achievements

  • Full Xbox controller support

Start Small. Dig Deep.
Begin your journey in a quiet graveyard, uncovering buried tombs and gathering your first resources. Every strike reveals something hidden beneath the soil…

From Silence to Chaos
What starts as a slow excavation quickly spirals into a storm of effects, chain reactions, and overwhelming resource generation. The graveyard is no longer quiet…

Grow Stronger with Every Upgrade
Unlock powerful abilities, enhance your digging efficiency, and discover new ways to harvest forbidden resources. Progress is the key to uncovering deeper secrets.

Assemble Your Own Creation
Piece by piece, bring your creature to life. Combine bones, flesh, and rare components to craft a unique creation… and unleash it.

Welcome to the Dark Web.

Fraudster is a tension-filled simulation game where you manage the underworld's biggest cybercrime network from a single computer screen in an ordinary room. Your goal is clear: use your intellect, survive ruthless threats, and sit at the top as the highest-earning fraudster in the world!

BUILD YOUR OWN CRIME EMPIRE

  • Credit Card Hunting: Set up various phishing scripts aimed at different targets to trap your victims. You can either sell the stolen credit card data directly on the Dark Web for quick cash, or take much bigger risks.

  • 3D Secure & Manipulation: Bypass 3D Secure firewalls for massive payouts! Use stolen cards to send massive donations to famous streamers to launder the money, or place fake orders to other people's addresses and take your commission.

  • Bank Hacking & Money Laundering: Want to scale up? Infiltrate your victims' direct bank accounts. But withdrawing this money to your own account isn't easy; you must find rented bank accounts and fool the system to launder the money without a trace.

ALWAYS STAY ON YOUR TOES

  • Cops and Hitmen: As you get richer, your enemies multiply! While managing your operations, you must hide your tracks from cyber police and protect yourself from hitmen (the mafia) about to knock on your door to survive. If you get caught or killed, your empire crumbles.

  • Time and Energy Management: Staying at the computer all night isn't easy. Control your fatigue, gather your energy, and finish your tasks before morning comes.

  • Be the Best in the World: Leave your rivals behind on the competitive Leaderboard! If you are cunning enough, you can become the legendary fraudster who made the most money.

Have you wiped all your tracks? Then turn on your computer and let the hunt begin.

Free Ball is a fast-paced third-person multiplayer volleyball game where you take control of your own character and play a specific role on the court. Every role has unique responsibilities that contribute to your team's success.

Choose from a roster of unique characters, each equipped with their own special abilities that can change the momentum of every rally. Receive powerful serves, make accurate sets, unleash devastating spikes, time your blocks, and outplay your opponents through skill, positioning, and teamwork.

Third-person Volleyball

Experience volleyball from an immersive third-person perspective that puts you directly on the court. Read the play, react to every touch, and execute clutch plays with precise player control.

Select Your Role

Play as a Left Hitter, Middle Hitter, Right Hitter, or Setter. Master each volleyball position, each with its own responsibilities and playstyle. Unleash powerful spikes, form solid blocks, deliver accurate sets, or keep rallies alive with perfectly timed receives.

Unique Characters with Special Abilities

Choose from a diverse roster of characters, each equipped with a signature ability that can turn the momentum of a match. Build team compositions and adapt your strategy around every character's strengths.

Skill-based Gameplay

Success comes from smart decision-making and precise execution. Find the open court and place your attacks exactly where you want them. Every rally is unpredictable. Mix up powerful spikes and roll shots, challenge blockers, defend against relentless attacks, and capitalize on your opponents' mistakes to win crucial points.

Multiplayer Volleyball

Work together with your teammates and execute coordinated combination plays to outplay the competition.

The year is 997, and Christendom is holding its breath for the end of the world. You're getting paid either way.

Free Company is a co-op tactical RPG about a band of sellswords carving a living out of a fracturing medieval world. From the Viking-raided coasts of the North Sea to the courts of Al-Andalus and the sands of the Maghreb.

Recruit a roster of hard-bitten war-bands, take contracts from kings, bishops and caliphs. Or seize a place of your own. Settle every fight with deep, deliberate, turn-based tactics where a single bad decision can cost you a veteran forever.

Play alone, or bring your friends into a shared campaign you can drop in and out of. The world waits for you.

Key Features

  • Command war-bands, not lone soldiers. Every unit is a named captain leading a file of men: a bracing spear wall, a shield line, a lone assassin slipping through the dark. Attrition whittles them and losing the captain is a wound that doesn't heal.

  • Deep turn-based combat. Action points, reaction interrupts, cover, reach and shield walls. Maces and crossbows punch through mail; arrows don't. Fire panics horses. Permadeath means every fight matters.

  • A living mercenary roster. Hire from a broad cast of captains: a disgraced Norman lord, an exiled Byzantine strategos, a Berber raider-chief, a heretic alchemist. Each with their own quirks, flaws and dry, needling banter. They're jaded professionals: nobody refuses a paycheck, so any legend fits your line.

  • Guerrilla strategy across a fractured map. Seize the passes, fords, ports and silver mines that decide a region. Serve a patron the easy way, or burn your standing to carve out holdings of your own and answer to no one.

  • Drop-in / drop-out co-op. One persistent company; the world pauses between sessions, so play together whenever you can and no one falls behind.

  • A world on the edge of the millennium. Is the dread real, or only fear? Zealots and cold rationalists each make their case and the game never tells you who's right.

  • 1000 AD, Europe & North Africa. Norse huscarls, Byzantine cataphracts, Magyar horse-archers, Berber camel corps, Fatimid fire-throwers and more. Every band a distinct answer on the battlefield.

Take the coin. Keep your company alive. Decide what you'll become before the year turns.

Time is coming apart. You wake in a clock tower with no memory of who you are or how you got here — only a pocket watch, still warm in your hand, an empty room, and a letter in your master's careful script: time is fracturing, and you are the one who must gather the broken moments back, one piece at a time. So you step out into a world that has stopped making sense.

Freeze Line is a hand-crafted action-puzzle built around a single, deadly-simple power: freeze the moment, line up your move, and dash through everything that wants you dead. No fluff, no filler — just you, a held breath, and the one clean line that carries you to the other side.

Freeze & Dash

Halt time. Drag to aim. Release, and slip through the gap no one else can see — between the swing of a clockwork blade, past the reach of a living vine, across the hush beneath the ice. Every screen is a small, sharp puzzle you solve at the speed of a heartbeat. Easy to pick up. Ruthless to truly master.

Echoes of Broken Time

The longer time stays broken, the stranger your hold on it becomes. One by one, you learn to bend the frozen moment into new shapes:
  • Leave a ghost of yourself behind and walk two paths at once.
  • Split off a shadow that takes the killing blow meant for you.
  • Freeze a lethal thing solid and simply stroll across it.
  • Tear a rift open beneath an enemy and cast them out of the moment entirely.
  • And, when the end demands it, bring the pocket watch's final judgment down on something that should never have moved.

Gather the Shards

Leave the tower and cross a world coming undone. A rainforest shrine slowly swallowed by living vines. A fortress sealed in black ice, where the cold still keeps voices that should have gone quiet long ago. Buried ruins under the desert, where the sand whispers your own name back to you. Every place hides a shard of broken time. Every room is placed by hand — no procedural filler, no wasted steps. And every road ends with something that guards its shard to the last. Some of those things were people, once.

The Truth at the Tower

Carry the shards back to the one who set you on this road. What waits for you there rewrites everything that came before — the task you were given, the shards you bled for, even who you thought you were. And the last turn of the story is not fixed: what you choose, and what you chose long before you understood it, decides how time finally comes to rest.

A Story Told Twice

Nothing here is only what it looks like. A line of dialogue, a locked door, a face behind the ice — the details you walk past on the way out mean something else entirely on the way home. It's a game built to be finished, and then seen again with clearer eyes.

Made With Respect

  • Every room placed by hand, every secret earned — no filler, no dark patterns.
  • Full keyboard & mouse or controller support (Xbox / DualSense).

From Cleaner to Hotel Owner

Start your journey as a hotel cleaner with nothing but a few basic tools and a determination to work your way to the top. Clean rooms, satisfy demanding guests, earn money, and build your own hotel business from the ground up.

Every room tells a different story. Remove stains, vacuum dirty carpets, clean windows and mirrors, dust furniture, scrub bathrooms, wipe tables and nightstands, replace broken light bulbs, and make every room spotless before the next guests arrive.

As you earn more money, invest in better opportunities. Purchase your first hotel, renovate it, and transform it into a successful business. Upgrade rooms with premium furniture and decorations to increase their value, allowing you to charge higher prices and attract happier guests.

Managing your hotel is about more than just appearances. Hire employees to help with daily operations while you focus on expanding your business. Keep guests satisfied, respond to their needs, and earn positive reviews that will grow your reputation.

Expand your property, unlock new possibilities, and turn a small hotel into a thriving hospitality empire. Every decision matters—from room design and pricing to staffing and customer satisfaction.

Can you build the most successful hotel in town?

Features

  • 🧹 Clean hotel rooms from top to bottom.

  • 🪟 Wash windows, mirrors, bathrooms, furniture, carpets, and more.

  • 💡 Replace broken light bulbs and keep every room guest-ready.

  • 💰 Earn money through hard work and smart management.

  • 🏨 Buy your own hotels and expand your business.

  • 🛋️ Decorate and upgrade rooms with better furniture.

  • 📈 Increase room quality to charge higher prices.

  • 👥 Hire employees to help manage your hotels.

  • 😊 Keep guests happy to receive better reviews.

  • 🌿 Enjoy a relaxing, cozy first-person simulation experience.

Your first machine is just the beginning. In FROM ZERO: Idle Factory, turn a small production setup into a growing manufacturing business, one investment at a time.

Build the chain. Keep it moving.

Place machines, turn components into finished products and let transport robots carry materials through your factory. Expand the floor and untangle production bottlenecks as new products open up.

Make the next upgrade count

A faster machine isn't always the answer. Improve product quality, strengthen logistics or expand power and water capacity to support your next production line. Research machine parts, fit the ones you need and sell the rest.

Keep building toward something new

  • 5 factories, from basic manufacturing to advanced robotics.
  • 30 products linked through component production and assembly.
  • 36 projects with choices between high-volume production and a focus on quality.

A campaign with a finish line

Build toward a final goal in a single-player campaign. There are no prestige resets: your progress moves forward. Production runs while the game is open, with no offline earnings. Save your progress and return to it when you're ready.

about_html:
Fruit Slicer is a fast-paced arcade action game where precision and speed are everything. Slice through flying fruit, avoid deadly hazards, and chase the highest score as the game constantly increases in intensity.

Core Gameplay

Cut through fruit with clean, satisfying motions to build combos and earn points. Stay focused, because a single mistake can cost you a life.

  • Responsive and satisfying slicing mechanics

  • Dangerous bombs that must be avoided

  • Increasing difficulty that tests your reflexes

Unique Controls

Play the way you prefer:

  • Classic mouse controls for fast and accurate slicing

  • Camera-based mode that lets you control the game with real hand movement

Power-ups and Mechanics

Use special effects to survive longer and improve your performance:

  • Freeze ability that slows down or stops the action

  • Score multipliers for higher rewards

  • Special fruit with unique behaviors

Progression

Each run contributes to your overall progress:

  • Earn coins by slicing whole fruit

  • Upgrade abilities to enhance your playstyle

  • Unlock character customization and visual effects

Why Play?

Fruit Slicer combines simple controls with deep, skill-based gameplay, creating a highly replayable experience that keeps you coming back for another run.

Start with a small neighborhood fruit store and build a place of your own. Fruit Store Simulator is a first-person management game where you handle the produce, serve the customers, and decide how the business grows. Between deliveries and the next customer in line, there's always something that needs your attention.

Run the Shop Yourself

Order stock on the computer, carry in crates or move them with a handcart, and fill your displays. Set prices, weigh loose produce, print labels, scan purchases, and count out change. Head to the cutting board or juicer to prepare fresh orders while the rest of the store keeps moving.

Create Your Own Bottled Juice

Choose your fruit and experiment with different proportions. Give your recipe a name, set its price, and turn it into bottled juice to sell alongside your produce. Save recipes for later and train employees to make them, bringing your own creations into the shop's everyday business.

Look After Every Crate

Fruit keeps changing after it arrives. Sort out damaged and spoiled pieces, decide what needs to sell first, and give the rest suitable storage. Rent the warehouse next door and organize crates on racks, with ventilation and cooling to help care for your stock. More stock means more decisions about space, freshness, and waste.

Get Ready for Busy Days

Check the calendar for festivals and local events, then plan your stock and prices around changing demand. Accept bulk orders and have the requested fruit and ripeness ready for collection. Balance purchases against rent and wages, and decide whether a bank loan can help fund your next step.

Build a Team You Can Rely On

Hire employees, train their skills, and set priorities for checkout, restocking, preparation, produce care, cleaning, and security. As the shop gets busier, share the work and step in where you're needed. Keep an eye out for shoplifters and robberies, and invest in security equipment and trained staff to protect the business.

Make the Store Yours

Reinvest your earnings in more space, new equipment, and a wider selection from your suppliers. Arrange displays and workstations, lay new flooring, change the walls, and adjust the lighting. Design your shop sign with your own name, colors, and logo, and turn a modest storefront into a place that feels like yours.

Get to Know the Neighborhood

The people around your shop have their own plans and problems. Meet them through visits, conversations, and emails as their stories unfold alongside your daily work. Build your business while becoming part of the neighborhood.

Key Features

  • 31 kinds of fruit to unlock, stock, price, and sell by unit or weight.

  • Fresh orders and your own recipes: prepare cut fruit and juice, and create bottled juice with your own recipe names and prices.

  • Produce care and storage: manage ripening, sort damaged fruit, and organize stock with warehouse racks and cooling equipment.

You fell asleep in a museum after closing. It's past 11pm. The shutters are down, and every door is locked.

Instead, one wall is open. Behind it are 23 rooms. Clear all of them, or you're not going home.

Three rules.

1. Reach the glowing portal to clear each course.

2. If you die, the course restarts from the beginning.

3. …and don't believe everything you see.

The dodge you learned in the last room is what kills you in the next. Still, every trap has a real answer.

GALLERY OF LIES is a first-person escape game made of nothing but traps and lies.

The controls are walk, jump and look. That's it.

PLAY TIME

2 to 3 hours for a first run. Longer if you get stuck.

CONTROLS

WASD / Arrow keys – Move

Mouse – Look

Space – Jump

Shift – Run

SAVING

Progress is saved automatically each time you reach a new course, and you can continue from the title screen.

There are no saves inside a course. Die, and it restarts from the beginning.

STREAMING

Streams, videos and clips are all fine, monetized or not. Laugh and scream all you want.

Feel free to tag me on X (@kim1_ml) if you post one.

Japanese / English / Simplified Chinese (switchable in-game)

GARITO is a slots roguelike where the house cheats first and you cheat it back.

Every machine is a boss, and it will not pay on its own. You reach into the reels, wire the paylines and STRIKE when the board is yours.

Rig the reels

Tap a cell, duplicate it, swap it with another. Every edit changes what the board is about to pay, and the plate tells you before you commit.

One strike collects it all

STRIKE pays every lit line, then runs the board again with a bigger multiplier, and again. Reach the goal and the overload is yours. Go bankrupt and the house collects.

Sabotage orders

Scissors, stamp, claw, tape, gum: thirteen ways to tamper with a strip for the rest of the run, each shown as a hologram before you press.

Wire your own paylines

Throw a fuse at a line's plug and the line lights, pays and climbs. A better fuse replaces the one in the socket.

The vending machine and the pachinko

Every overload you clear is paid in tickets. Spend them between machines: a pachinko where the ball decides what you take, or spare parts that bolt onto the machine for the whole run.

Every machine is a boss

Ten machines, each with a face, a trick and a breaking point. Beat its payout out of it and it shatters; TIMO, the raccoon in the back room, counts what you took.

The workshop

Every machine you break leaves scrap. Between runs you spend it on the wall: fifty-eight upgrades along five fronts, rigging, betting, wiring, haggling and holding on, from a third trick per deal to a bet on the goal and a street market before the first machine.

Ten boss machines, twenty symbols, thirteen sabotages, nine fuses, ten spare parts, fifty-eight workshop upgrades, and seeded runs you can share in six letters.

The house always collects. Unless you rig it first.

No real money, no microtransactions: what you lose here is fake credits.

The world has stories beyond your sight

As you follow the road, villagers return to work and other adventurers head toward their next destination. GEKOKUJO: Vagrant Crown is a third-person Living World RPG about traveling with your wolf companion. Not everyone in this world is waiting for you to arrive.

A wolf at your side

Cross forests, follow riverside roads, and pause in villages along the way. Your Wolf Companion is more than a pet: a fellow traveler on the journey. Look beyond the next objective and discover the scenery and encounters between destinations.

The people you meet have lives of their own

Villagers and wandering adventurers have daily routines and goals. Work, rest, travel, and social ties continue while you explore elsewhere. We are building a world where remembering someone's name—and meeting them again—can mean more than another line of dialogue.

Your adventure leaves a trace

Encounters and witnessed events can live on through memories and rumors. The people you meet and the relationships you form connect one encounter to the next. A story heard on the road may offer a glimpse of what happened beyond your sight. This is the kind of adventure we are developing: one that reaches beyond the moment in front of you.

Travel, fight, and grow together

Journey with companions, take on requests, and shape your approach to battle through equipment and jobs. Long-term Party Members and people who join for a particular purpose play different roles. Meeting, fighting alongside, and parting with others are all part of the journey.

Battle, jobs, and companion coordination are still being refined. Confirmed party sizes, available jobs, and individual events will be announced as their scope is finalized.

A world still taking shape

GEKOKUJO is a pre-release game in development. We are bringing exploration, NPC encounters, requests, and battle together so that one meeting can lead to the next story. Images include work-in-progress content. The full game and demo have different content scopes.

Streaming, Videos & Monetization Welcome!

Individuals and organizations are welcome to create gameplay streams, livestreams, Let's Plays, reviews, video essays, promotional coverage, clips, Shorts, and other gameplay videos featuring GEKOKUJO: Vagrant Crown or its publicly released demo. No prior permission, registration, or notification is required.

Publish on YouTube, Twitch, Niconico, TikTok, or other platforms in accordance with their rules. Monetization through advertising, memberships, donations, Super Chats, sponsorships, and standard creator programs is welcome.

You may use in-game footage, audio, and screenshots in gameplay commentary, reviews, and coverage. Credit and links to the game are appreciated, but not required. Enjoy your adventure and freely share your experience!

This permission does not cover infringement of third-party rights, unauthorized redistribution or sale of standalone game assets, impersonation of the developer, or unlawful use.

GET COOKED is a multiplayer game where two rival restaurants share one city — and only one team walks away the winner. Cook, sell, and build up your base while the clock ticks down… because when the war siren sounds, the fences drop and your rivals are coming for everything you built.

You owe 200 million won to men who don't take excuses.

It's 1999. A folding table in a back room in Busan. Between you and the collector there are forty-eight hwatu cards and nothing else.

GO, STOP is a roguelike deckbuilder built on the flower-card game Koreans have played for a hundred years. At funerals, at holidays, and in rooms like this one. Match the month. Sweep the floor. Turn flowers into money before sunrise.

Never held a hwatu deck?
Neither had our testers. There's no tutorial that sits you down. Every card carries its month, the codex is one click away, and the game explains each situation the first time it happens. By the second night you'll be reading the floor like you grew up on it.

Sets aren't points. They're multipliers.
Three Brights is ×5. Godori is ×6. Land both in one round and you're at thirty times the pot. Charms bend the scoring rules; gwipae — sixty cards that exist on no real hwatu deck — multiply the whole total on top. Stack them and the numbers stop looking like a card game.

The choice the game is named after
Hit the target and the table asks: take it now, or call Go and double the multiplier. Every Go doubles what's on the table. It also raises the target and hands the man across from you one more chance to take everything. Lose it and he takes your wallet too.

Stop is safe. Stop is also how you end the night short of what you owe.

Cheating is a feature. Getting caught is the problem.
Pull a card from the bottom of the deck. Shake the table when you're holding three of a month. Bury the floor with a bomb. Every trick works — until the man across from you notices. One card from the bottom is an 8% chance. Three is a third of the time. And every attempt that night makes the next one worse.

What you build across a night
Fifty charms that break the scoring rules in ways they shouldn't. Sixty gwipae. Consumables, card editions, and scoring sets that sharpen every time you grind them. Eight cities, eight bosses, each one breaking a different rule of the game.

The debt doesn't sleep
The principal grows every time you move to a new city. Interest comes due every third night whether you're ready or not. Short? Borrow more. That's how they get you.

Three nights per city. Eight cities from Busan to Seoul. And one ledger with your name on it.

Goblin Electric Ltd. owes a fortune. It has two employees left, one very old generator, and Mr. Chan the debt collector never misses a payday. There is one way out: march into the wilds, capture giant monsters that run on electricity, plug them into the company's grid and sell the spare power to the town.

From two goblins to a crew of twenty


Pick up new hands at recruit camps and rescues until twenty goblins march behind you. Twenty classes, each with one job: Workers swarm, Bruisers crack armor, Spark Techs chain lightning through the guards, Medics patch everyone up, Wranglers rope giants down and Turret Engineers fire wherever you point – and later Thunder Chanters, Crossbowmen, the Big Guys in their power suits, Welders, Blowers, Drone Operators and Cryo Techs. Every goblin rolls their own stats and hidden traits.

You're the Boss


Before each battle, choose where every squad stands and what it carries. Then your crew fights on its own. You steer the Boss himself: click the ground to send him running, click a downed goblin to help them back up. Aim the Turret Engineers' missiles with your cursor, and call the capture when the moment is right.

Break it. Topple it. Capture it.


Giants don't go down quietly. Smash their armored parts, knock them off their feet, then send in the Wranglers with ropes before they get back up. The Thunderback Tortoise, the Giant Furnace Toad, the Volt Crab, the Drill Mole and the Mushroom Mother – each one a power plant on legs.

Three maps, each nastier than the last


The Abandoned Power Valley, the Old Mine and the Mushroom Marsh each have their own routes, monsters, materials and hazards, from rockfalls to spore clouds. Every expedition follows a branching route of battles, elites, giants, camps, supplies and strange encounters. After a giant or elite fight you may retreat and keep what you've hauled – but if the whole crew goes down, the cargo goes with them.

A cave, a town and a breeding room


Captured creatures power the company, and the spare power sells at every step of the road. Each finished map opens a new base: the town has a Power Exchange and a Labor Agency, and the Breeding Room raises small creatures, hatches eggs and harvests materials. Materials depend on where and how you get them: won in fights, broken off a giant's armor, or sheared from a creature you brought home.

Office life, goblin-style

Old Pick, Rivet, Granny Morel, Fa the Gambler and Kid Vet join the company along the way, and their little skits bring blueprints for new facilities. And then there's Mr. Chan, who stamps every installment right on time.

Features

  • Grow from 2 goblins to a crew of 20, squad by squad
  • 20 classes in semi-automatic battles: you plan the squads, then steer the Boss
  • Giant monsters to break, topple and capture alive
  • Three maps with branching routes and a retreat-or-push-on choice after every big fight
  • Three bases – a cave, a town and a breeding room – that run on what you bring home
  • Five companions, and a debt collector who is never late
  • Hand-made pixel art and an 8-bit chiptune soundtrack
  • Play in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French or Spanish

Run a restaurant on a planet that wants you gone.

You set out on this journey as a celebrated chef. Somewhere along the way, you became someone who cooks to survive. The ship crashed on a planet that will never open its doors to you. All that's left is you, Nekobot the service robot, and a kitchen that barely survived the crash. There is only one way to live here: turn the wreck into a restaurant and make money.

EVERYTHING HAS A PRICE

Everything you spend costs you something. Will you cook, make the restaurant worth visiting, or set out to explore? Or will you repair the ship, hoping to leave this planet behind? The game runs in real time with pause, and the clock is your hardest customer.

NEKOBOT, YOUR ONLY CREW

Nekobot is the only crew you have left. Send it into the unknown to chart routes and find out who else lives out there, or keep it close to help: research, repairs, serving tables, clearing the deck. Wherever Nekobot goes, it isn't somewhere else.

A RESTAURANT FROM THE WRECKAGE

Clear the debris, repair the kitchen, and place tables in what's left of the ship. Every repair and every scrap of salvage is a bet on tomorrow's customers.

THE EMPIRE IS WATCHING YOU

This planet belongs to the Empire. It sells you what you need at its market, then takes its tax from what you earn. Pay, or fall into debt and out of favor. The consequences arrive in uniform.

Out in the wastes, wandering traders offer another way. Nekobot just has to find them first.

WHAT WILL THIS KITCHEN BE?

Sooner or later, you have to decide what kind of restaurant you are running.

Serve the many: cheap food, long lines, and a planet that slowly learns to need you.

Or serve the few: the Empire's officers and the corrupt elite, who pay a fortune for rare meat and never ask where it came from. Out here, the rarest meat still walks and talks.

One path keeps you honest. The other keeps you rich. Neither keeps your hands clean.
